nameOrigin: Greek god (aka Heracles) and type of beetle

pokedexEntries.go: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.

pokedexEntries.si: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

pokedexEntries.cr: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

pokedexEntries.ru: HERACROSS charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This POKéMON even has enough power to topple a massive tree.

pokedexEntries.sa: HERACROSS has sharp claws on its feet. These are planted firmly into the ground or the bark of a tree, giving the POKéMON a secure and solid footing to forcefully fling away foes with its proud horn.

pokedexEntries.fr: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

pokedexEntries.lg: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

pokedexEntries.em: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

pokedexEntries.di: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.

pokedexEntries.prl: With powerful legs and claws, it generates enough power to hurl foes over great distances.

pokedexEntries.pt: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

pokedexEntries.hg: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

pokedexEntries.ss: It is usually docile, but if it is disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

pokedexEntries.bw: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

pokedexEntries.x: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

pokedexEntries.y: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

pokedexEntries.or: Heracross charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokémon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.

pokedexEntries.as: Heracross has sharp claws on its feet. These are planted firmly into the ground or the bark of a tree, giving the Pokémon a secure and solid footing to forcefully fling away foes with its proud horn.

pokedexEntries.us: It’s proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it’s always fighting with.

pokedexEntries.um: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it’s not that good at flying.

pokedexEntries.sw: Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon takes pride in its strength, which allows it to lift things 100 times heavier than itself with no trouble at all.

pokedexEntries.bd: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.

pokedexEntries.shp: Its powerful legs and claws give it enough power to hurl foes over great distances.

pokedexEntries.la: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it’s capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

pokedexEntries.sc: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

pokedexEntries.vi: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.
